title: Ramp customer stories
description: A centred two-tone statement with an acid-lime button, then alternating half-and-half rows: a two-tone heading and arrow link at the top of the text column, a customer quote with a hanging opening mark at its foot, and a large square 12px-rounded film frame with a frosted 'watch' pill on the other side.
notes: each row's media slot is a square frame (753×753 at 1440); empty, it shows a grey gradient placeholder
on phones each row stacks heading, frame, then quote
